preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an even length n between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be 'YES' if two balanced bracket sequences exist, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: possible and len(a) == n and len(b) == n
postconditions.description: If possible, the output must include two balanced bracket sequences a and b of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(a[i] == b[i] if s[i] == '1' else a[i] != b[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For all positions i, if s[i] is '1', a[i] must equal b[i]; if s[i] is '0', a[i] must not equal b[i]'.
